overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that halt_high_risk being True would block all high-risk buys, but the condition requires both halt_high_risk AND sleeve == "high_risk". A buy with a non-high-risk sleeve passes through even when the drawdown halt is active.
why_it_breaks: The drawdown halt sets halt_high_risk = True when drawdown <= -0.20 (i.e., -20% or worse). The guard at line 276 then blocks only buys that also have sleeve == "high_risk". If FALN was assigned a core or other sleeve, the condition fails and the order proceeds without any warning, even though the portfolio is already past the -20% halt threshold. The agent overlooked that the sleeve check acts as an additional filter, allowing non-high-risk buys to bypass the halt entirely.
